correctness.rationale: The three-probe Crofton identity is exact. The spherical-distance Taylor coefficient and Jacobian are computed under bounded exponential coordinates; a global no-cut exponential bound proves termwise integrability and O(n^-3) remainder. Exact Dirichlet/radial identities I0=4pi²/7, IR=32pi²/11, IT=8pi²/11 were reconstructed with an executable rational checker from this record. The gamma(4) moments give -10 and 65; the remaining curvature coefficient is -28pi²/11.

originality.rationale: No equivalent or dominating cubic cell-area power-sum asymptotic was identified among five real semantic searches, accessible own finding claims, and the directly relevant primary literature. Critically, Hug–Schneider's broad covariance theorem stops at degree two for an unweighted typical cell, whereas the claimed area-weighted second moment is degree three. Leading Poisson scaling and first expected intrinsic volumes are credited. Miles (1971) remains a named full-text historical risk.

value.rationale: The squared area of the area-biased great-circle cell is the genuine third power-sum invariant, not the already known first or second raw moment. It describes spatially encountered cell-size heterogeneity and quantifies the separate binomial count and intrinsic spherical curvature corrections, a nonroutine exact multi-point geometric integral for an infinite ensemble.
